source: Live fetch of artofliving.org pages and robots.txt / llms.txt on 2026-11-14

facts.finding: No meta description on the Canada home page (og:description is empty too).
Could not confirm any schema.org JSON-LD (the fetcher strips scripts). Course and Event schema were not visible.
No FAQ section on the home or programs pages.
Program listing shows no format, duration or price, which are the facts AI answers quote.
llms.txt exists but is US-centric (about 80 KB), lists only one Canadian entry (/ca-en/) and appears truncated mid-link.
robots.txt has no rules blocking GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot or Google-Extended, so AI crawlers are allowed. Good.

Search results show Canadian pages with slug-like titles such as "i 504", "home 4", "global project template", "events old" and "service individual 0". Stale or test pages are indexed and dilute the real ones.
/ca-en/sky-breath-meditation, /ca-en/art-living-part-1 and /ca-en/centers return client errors for automated fetchers.
